resources.string: The most characters one chat line may hold on the platform that delivers it: 500
The text cut to fit one chat line, ending in an ellipsis or in your own end text: short text
The text cut to fit one chat line, at the last whole word: short text
A name with an @ in front so chat pings it: @ViewerTwo
A name without the @, so nobody is pinged: ViewerTwo
A name with an invisible space inside it, so it shows but does not ping: ViewerTwo
The viewer who triggered this, with an @ in front: @ViewerOne
The text as an action line on Twitch (/me), plain text elsewhere: /me dances
The chat message that triggered this: hello big world
How many characters the trigger message has: 15
How many bits came with the trigger message: 0
true while the channel is in a shared chat session, false when not
The other channels in the shared chat session, separated by commas: OtherStreamer
The slow mode wait time, or off: 3s
How long a viewer must follow before chatting (on when any follower may chat), or off: 10m
true while subscribers-only chat is on, false when not
true while emote-only chat is on, false when not
The text of the pinned chat message, empty when nothing is pinned: Welcome to the stream
Text made ready to be spoken: no links, no @, no emotes of the channel, fancy letters turned to plain ones: hi ViewerTwo hi
Text made ready to be spoken, with the emote names kept: hi KEKW
Whole numbers in the text written as words, in the channel language: I have three cats
The text with the channel pronunciation list applied: good game
A link that opens X with the text ready to post: https://x.com/intent/post?text=Live%20now
A link that opens Bluesky with the text ready to post: https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=Live%20now
A link that opens Threads with the text ready to post: https://www.threads.net/intent/post?text=Live%20now
A link that opens a Mastodon server (first argument) with the text ready to post: https://mastodon.social/share?text=Live%20now
